<function name="GetPhysicsObjectCount" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns the number of physics objects an entity has (usually 1 for non-ragdolls)</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">numObjects</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Finds all the Physics Objects in a ragdoll and applies an upward force</description>
	<code>
for i=0, ragdoll:GetPhysicsObjectCount() - 1 do -- "ragdoll" being a ragdoll entity
 
	local phys = ragdoll:GetPhysicsObjectNum(i)
	phys:ApplyForceCenter( Vector( 0, 0, 10000 ) )

end
	</code>

</example>
